Introducing Saved Views, a new way to organize how you and your team work. Saved Views is available today for every customer, included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorts, and grouping each time you open a project, you can now save your favorite configurations and return to them instantly with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every project, sprint, or workflow you manage across your workspace. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or reviewing work by priority, your setup stays exactly how you left it.

Saved Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps. Share a view with teammates and keep everyone aligned on what matters most, whether that's a status report for leadership or a daily standup list for engineers.

We hope this update makes daily planning easier and more consistent for everyone on your team. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
